name: AWS SDK JS v2 to v3
description: Migrates AWS SDK v2 monolithic client usage to modular AWS SDK v3 client packages and command executions.

transformations.description: Replace AWS.S3 or { S3 } import with modular @aws-sdk/client-s3 S3Client
Replace new AWS.S3() with new S3Client()
Migrate direct s3.listObjectsV2 calls to s3.send with command objects
